title: Competition Sculpture Series
description: Four reference-linked chocolate showpieces preserving one studio pedestal and lighting system.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the dark pedestal, softbox reflection logic, and balanced grand-prix scale. Images 02-04 preserve that exact studio system while rotating the sculpture language from ribbons to spires and chocolate-sugar fusion.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-lacquer-pedestal-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
